neighbours.label: A small set of tokens: ' VIP', ' gala', ' finer', ' elite' (the card adds Korean ' 대부분' and Russian ' состоянии'). The English four share a 'select / high-end occasion' sense, but near-synonyms (' luxury', ' exclusive') stay quiet, so this is the token list, not the meaning.
fire: Our seats were in the VIP section, right behind the dugout.
The charity holds a gala every December to raise money for the clinic.
My grandfather taught me the finer details of pruning roses.
Only elite runners are allowed to start in the first wave.
The sponsors were given VIP passes for the whole weekend.
She wore a green dress to the gala at the opera house.
The regiment was an elite unit trained for mountain warfare.
A good editor notices the finer shades of meaning in a sentence.

A good editor notices the subtle shades of meaning in a sentence.
